name: Jellicent

abilities.name: Bouncy Body
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, take a {Water} Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavor:
Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky,
schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of
the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

pokedex.text: NO. 0593 Floating Pokémon HT: 7'3" WT: 297.6 lbs.
